invariants.rationale: The method directly returns the input records list, so the result is the exact same object as the input.
Since result and records are the same object, their sizes are always equal.
Regardless of the value of outputPartitions, the method always returns records; this captures that outputPartitions does not affect the output.
records is a parameter and must be non-null to reach this point, so result (which is records) is also non-null.
